faq.headline: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheadline: Straight answers on scope, timelines, and ownership.

items.question: How do you price engagements?
items.answer: We provide custom proposals based on scope, complexity, and expected impact. No hourly rate menus or hidden costs.

items.question: What timelines should we expect?
items.answer: Discovery typically takes 1-2 weeks. Builds range from 2-week sprints to 12-week MVPs depending on scope.

items.question: What tech stack do you use?
items.answer: We work primarily with TypeScript, Python, Next.js, FastAPI, AWS, and modern data tooling based on the best fit.

items.question: How do you handle security and privacy?
items.answer: We apply least-privilege access, secure data handling, and clear boundaries for data usage. We do not resell or reuse client data.

items.question: Who owns the code and IP?
items.answer: Clients own the code, data, and IP by default unless otherwise agreed in writing.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We offer either a clean handover with documentation or an ongoing retainer for improvements and support.

items.question: Can you work alongside our internal team?
items.answer: Yes. We can collaborate with internal teams, provide architecture guidance, or take full delivery ownership.

items.question: Do you build MVPs or only full systems?
items.answer: We build both. MVPs are designed to scale, not as throwaway prototypes.
